tool.name: evaluate_ludb.py
tool.gate_role: Detect delineation onset/offset regressions after internal moves and pipeline decomposition (doc 05 B: Phases 1 and 3; full set before Phase 3 completion).
tool.cadence: Every release; optional on PRs touching delineation (doc 06).

datasets.name: LUDB
datasets.subset_rule: All 200 records in RECORDS. The tool only exposes --n (first N of RECORDS) and reads LUDB from the fixed path <tool dir>/data/lobachevsky-...-1.0.1, so no record flag is passed.

record_schema_note: legacy ecgfeat export (pre-ECG-Record); no record schema is exercised by these tools at this revision

determinism.ungated_note: runtime/wall-clock values; environment-dependent, not gated, not a result difference

metrics.name: coverage.gt_qrs
